_about: Measured simulation, not applied. A temporary copy of the repository TUF data had the TUF 3 and TUF 4 proposals from nsac_tuf3_tuf4_audit_2026-09-13.json applied (commission result_sources, commission classification basis with record absence as corroboration, fight_date, commission method/round/time); scripts/tuf/completeness_matrix.mjs then ran against the copy with read-only database selects. Repository data unchanged.

remaining_blockers_explained.OPEN_SOURCE_CONFLICT: each season keeps one open bracket conflict the commission record informs but does not settle (see the audit conflicts section)
remaining_blockers_explained.ROSTER_MISSING: TUF 4 has no team rosters loaded; unrelated to commission evidence
remaining_blockers_explained.BRACKET_NAME_NOT_IN_ROSTER: follows from the missing TUF 4 rosters

fits_without_change: result_sources / classification_basis / fight_date / fight_date_source / commission_record_id on bouts
corrections (commission_correction, method_normalization) and method_detail for the one compatible detail (TUF 3 Rothaermel vs Bisping: strikes)
identity_disagreements on the document for DOB differences (Pointon, Hutcherson, Burnett, Sell)
commissionWeights display: 48/48 weights shown, 42 named by fighter; printed-name fallback for 6 corners whose printed first name differs (Abbadi, Carter x2, Spratt x2, Smith), fail-safe as designed
sudden-victory decisions: method "Decision (unanimous, sudden victory round)" (commission wording, primary normalization), round 3, scheduled_rounds 2, result_text as printed

transcription_keys_not_in_the_ledger_sha.winner_surname: audit helper; replaced by winner at apply
transcription_keys_not_in_the_ledger_sha.rounds_printed: redundant with method + scheduled_rounds + result_text; drop at apply
transcription_keys_not_in_the_ledger_sha.scorecard_order_printed: the printed typo "Lytle - Thomasr"; scorecards.order is normalized; drop at apply
transcription_keys_not_in_the_ledger_sha.date_printed: the one real gap: TUF 3 record 05 prints "02/0706". The ledger has no field for a misprinted value. Options for approval: (a) one optional generic CommissionRecord.date_printed, or (b) keep only the normalized 2006-02-07 and state the misprint in the bout correction reason. No schema is added in this audit.

decisions_for_apply: TUF 3 method contradictions: KO (punches), KO (head kick and punches) and Verbal submission (rib injury) against the commission TKO. The TUF 1 rule makes the commission category canonical with the draft label in corrections only; decide whether "head kick and punches" / "rib injury" survive as secondary detail despite the category change.
TUF 3 Singer vs Hutcherson misprinted date: option (a) or (b) above.
